temporary_goal: Confirm who made the impossible portal and whether it is safe.
strategy: Establish routine, inspect persistent construction details and cross when no ordinary explanation survives.
primary_location: West-rim homestead and north-wall portal cave
complications: The red marker and reversed torch are familiar but unclaimed; the private world excludes an ordinary builder.
reversal: The portal leads to the same ravine after destruction rather than to the Nether.
outcome: The protagonist enters by choice and loses temporal certainty.
production_note: Reuse one intact geography pass and reserve the portal reveal for the end of the descent.

temporary_goal: Find the wolf, identify the apparent survivor and recover a route home.
strategy: Match landmarks, search the burned homestead and pursue the ridge silhouette.
primary_location: Burned homestead, eastern ridge and surviving portal cave
complications: The pen is empty, the figure evades him and every block trace implies one location rather than a copy.
reversal: A second crossing ejects him before the portal was built.
outcome: He gains a possible culprit but becomes stranded in his own recent past.
story_state_afterward: Future loss becomes past opportunity under constraint.
production_note: Use matched compositions and one distant silhouette; conceal the wolf through terrain rather than editing deception.

temporary_goal: Warn the younger self and protect the wolf without stopping the journey.
strategy: Observe from cover, use local red wool as an indirect route marker and compare remembered cave details.
primary_location: Pre-discovery homestead perimeter and bare portal cave
complications: The younger self remains close; an explicit warning risks preventing entry; the incomplete marker is already part of memory.
reversal: His intervention proves participation, and the remembered frame details identify him as the necessary builder.
outcome: He chooses portal construction as the only rescue path he can support with evidence.
story_state_afterward: Hope of rewriting becomes responsibility for the known chain.
production_note: Restrict double-avatar overlap to sight lines, silhouettes and younger-self inserts.

temporary_goal: Complete the portal before the younger self arrives and preserve the foreknowledge-producing entry.
strategy: Mine local obsidian, copy the irregular construction and hide during the opening encounter.
primary_location: Lava shelf, portal cave and concealment ledge
complications: Time pressure encourages temporary spruce staging beside a route connected to the timber stair.
reversal: Lighting the solution to the mystery also creates the proposed cause of the fire.
outcome: The younger self enters; the older self sees smoke and races towards the house.
story_state_afterward: Builder mystery resolves while latent danger becomes immediate.
production_note: The candidate ignition geometry must be mechanically tested before construction continuity is locked.

temporary_goal: Prevent the known ruin, then save what remains meaningfully possible.
strategy: Fight the structure fire, recognise the failed resource allocation, redirect water to the eastern drain and release the wolf.
primary_location: Burning homestead, wolf pen, eastern drain and ridge
complications: Separated fire fronts consume the house; the wolf is seated behind a blocked yard; the arriving earlier self must not see it.
reversal: He abandons the roof, saves the wolf and deliberately becomes the silhouette that motivated him.
outcome: The ruin remains unchanged, the wolf survives and the portal is extinguished after the required crossing.
story_state_afterward: Fixed physical loss becomes chosen relational preservation.
production_note: Rehearse staged fire progression, water placement, wolf pathing, ridge occlusion and portal dousing separately.
